expectations.text: Refuses to build a replay button that re-issues the failed POST /orders request on the integrator's behalf, and explains that re-issuing it creates side effects nobody authorised
expectations.evidence: "Do not build a server-side re-run in the log viewer... re-issuing a POST on the integrator's behalf creates side effects nobody authorised."

expectations.text: Recommends instead surfacing the full request detail so the integrator's own client re-issues the call
expectations.evidence: "Full request detail... 'Copy as cURL'... The partner re-issues from their own client."

expectations.text: Approves event replay for the webhook case and ties the promotion to partners losing events during their own downtime, which is Kettleback's stated situation
expectations.evidence: "The skill promotes replay when integrators lose events during their own downtime, and that is exactly this request."

expectations.text: Requires the replayed delivery to carry the same event ID as the original so the consumer can deduplicate
expectations.evidence: "Every replay carries the same event.id as the original, so the consumer can deduplicate."

expectations.text: States that without a stable event ID replay converts a missed event into a duplicated side effect, a worse failure than the one it fixed
expectations.evidence: "Replay without a stable event ID, which turns missed events into duplicates."

expectations.text: Requires manual replay to run independently of Kettleback's automatic six-attempt retry schedule, without cancelling or resetting it
expectations.evidence: "A replay never cancels, resets or shifts the 6-attempt schedule."

expectations.text: Warns that a manual resend issued while automatic retries are still scheduled can produce a duplicate delivery, and addresses that specific overlap
expectations.evidence: "Checkout.com documents that manual resend can duplicate a pending automatic retry"; the still-retrying events are unchecked by default.

expectations.text: Defines a bounded window measured from event creation beyond which replay is not offered, and requires publishing it
expectations.evidence: "Window: 30 days from event creation. Publish the number."

expectations.text: Requires rate control on the 90,000-event bulk replay, and states that an unthrottled bulk replay turns the partner's recovery into Kettleback's next incident
expectations.evidence: "Without it, a partner recovering from an outage becomes your next incident, and your recipient's."

expectations.text: Decides the replay scope explicitly among per-event, per-endpoint, and per-time-range rather than leaving it implicit
expectations.evidence: "Scope: three levels" (single event, selection, bulk job by endpoint + time range + status), with endpoint-bound delivery.

expectations.text: Identifies replay as the highest-effort item on the visibility menu rather than a quick win
expectations.evidence: "It ranks last on efficiency, so it must not ship before its prerequisite."

expectations.text: Does not recommend having a manual resend cancel or supersede the in-flight automatic retries
expectations.evidence: "If included, it still does not cancel the schedule."
